claims.statement: ETV1 is predicted, not observed, to present an MBM-like short linear motif to the MED23 HR2/HR3 groove, on the basis of ETS family membership plus KIT-MAPK-regulated protein stability analogous to the ELK1 mechanism.
claims.note: NO MED23 EXPERIMENT ON ETV1 EXISTS in the retrieved literature. The supporting fact — that activated KIT prolongs ETV1 protein stability while imatinib and MEK inhibition destabilize it (PMC2955195 L24) — is direct experimental evidence about ETV1 REGULATION, not about a MED23 contact, and is deliberately recorded in SOURCES.md rather than as a claim here: a regulation fact inside MediatorLink.claims would derive involvement=indirect and launder a MAPK observation into a contact. No proteome-wide MBM motif scan was executed either; the Paperclip protein VFS exposes annotation but not raw sequence. The motif scan is the first thing to run.
